readme_excerpt: NGINX (pronounced "engine x" or "en-jin-eks") is the world's most popular Web Server, high performance Load Balancer, Reverse Proxy, API Gateway and Content Cache. NGINX is free and open source software, distributed under the terms of a simplified 2-clause BSD-like license. Enterprise distributions, commercial support and training are available from F5, Inc. > [!IMPORTANT] > The goal of this README is to provide a basic, structured introduction to NGINX for novice users.
